description: This file defines the 'Label' interface in the Eclipse Ditto project, representing a policy entry label with methods to create labels and retrieve associated JSON field definitions.

classes.name: Label
classes.description: An interface representing a policy entry label, extending CharSequence and providing static and default methods for label creation and JSON schema retrieval.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new Label from a character sequence, or returns the label directly if the input is already a Label.

methods.name: getJsonFieldDefinition
methods.description: Provides the JSON field definition associated with this label.
